title: Chapter 2939 - 172: Yin and Yang 2
content:
Chapter 2939: Chapter 172: Yin and Yang 2

At the same time, he regarded himself as a "deity," disregarding his own status as a "Straw Dog."

Under such powerful divinity, cold and rational insight and supremacy, Mo Hua’s "humanity" was further suppressed to an insignificant degree.

And this weakness of "humanity" greatly reduced the "pain" on his Divine Thought.

In the concept of Divine Sense, not clinging to one’s identity as a ’human,’ not sticking to the gains and losses of life and fame, brings one closer to divinity.

Mo Hua’s eyes nearly transformed entirely into gold.

Many of the emotions belonging to a human, along with the pains of being human, were also diminished.

Only in this way could he grit his teeth and continue to draw, continuing to carve his Lifebound Formation upon his own bones...

Then, the essence of wood white, melded with blood poison, flowed through the Twelve regular meridians along with the movement of Blood Qi, and under Mo Hua’s meticulous control by Divine Thought, continued to meander upon the bones, solidifying into the second stroke of Formation Patterns.

This time, the pain had faded considerably.

Mo Hua could continue drawing.

His Divine Thought continued to circulate, while the wood white essence, like "Spiritual Ink," continued to flow, sketching downwards...

The third stroke, the fourth stroke...

In this way, unknown how long had passed, the first Taotie Pattern was finally drawn by Mo Hua.

On Mo Hua’s thumb’s radial bone, a Taotie Pattern resembling a young fierce beast coagulated, trembling continuously with the flow of Blood Qi, almost as if it was breathing.

The first Taotie Pattern took shape.

Almost simultaneously, the sensation of being bitten by the Taotie became suddenly stronger.

Mo Hua could only invoke more divinity, continuing to suppress the pain on Divine Thought with absolute rationality and cold awareness.

This was an extremely grueling process.

This was a torment for Mo Hua’s Divine Soul and a test for his Taoist Heart.

Mo Hua forcibly endured the severe pain.

Finally, after an unknown amount of time, as the pain slightly receded, Mo Hua, with steadfast determination, continued drawing the second Taotie Pattern.

Second Grade Twenty-four Patterns, Taotie Spirit Formation.

He had only drawn one pattern at present, needing to draw twenty-three more Formation Patterns, and ultimately connect them all together to form the final Taotie Spirit Remains Formation.

This process was extraordinarily painful and long, so lengthy that it seemed there was no dawn in sight.

In the boundless darkness condensed by pain, Mo Hua didn’t know for how long he had drawn, nor how much prolonged suffering he had endured.

He didn’t know furthermore how many times he had forcibly invoked divinity to suppress his humanity...

Mo Hua could only, with cold rationality, as if he was a "Great Dao Machine," according to the Formation memory he had practiced countless times, with patience and endured torment, draw stroke by stroke, Pattern by Pattern...

He could only persist, focusing his mind to the extreme, with not a single distraction, having no other thoughts besides this.

Only in this way, could he continue to draw. At the end, Mo Hua even had a feeling of "certainty."

His bones were merely withered stones.

His body was merely earth and wood.

He lost the concept of "self."

He was not carving the Spiritual Corpse Formation on his own body.

Instead, he was drawing the Twelve Scripture Gluttonous Spirit Corpse Extremist Formation on the stone and earth of this world.

Mo Hua completely obliterated the "small self", transcended "pain", and infinitely approached divinity; in Mo Hua’s eyes, there was only the Formation, only heaven and earth, and the indescribable, self-operating, eternally unchanged "Dao"...

...

In this extreme "divinity" state, Mo Hua’s consciousness became increasingly clear.

The Formation under his pen seemingly gained divinity.

It was as if he was born to the Dao of Heaven and Earth, breathing in synchronization with the Law.

In this long conflict between divinity and humanity, the sprouting of pain, and the dissolution of self, Mo Hua persisted with his Taoist Heart until the end.

Finally, when Mo Hua’s Divine Thought was about to be exhausted, he drew the last stroke of the Taotie Pattern upon his own bones.

He also finally completely carved this Great Wilderness Twelve Classics Taotie Spirit Remains Formation, which he had practiced countless times and deduced countless times, upon his bones.

At that moment, the blue light shone blindingly.

A series of sinister Taotie Patterns began to emerge on Mo Hua’s skin.

A wisp of ancient Formation light ignited inside Mo Hua; it followed the meridians, from Hand Taiyin Lung Meridian to Hand Yangming Intestine Meridian, to Foot Yangming Stomach Meridian... until the final Hand Shaoyang Triple Burner Meridian, Foot Shaoyang Gallbladder Meridian, Foot Jueyin Liver Meridian, and finally back to Hand Taiyin Lung Meridian, forming a complete Twelve Meridians Circulation.

On the Circulation of Twelve regular meridians, interlinked the full twenty-four Taotie Patterns.

And these twenty-four Taotie Patterns, either bright or dark, continuously emerged, as if coming to life, within Mo Hua’s bones, organs, meridians, and flesh, continuously wriggling and merging, eventually wholly blending into one piece...

The Taotie Formation and his flesh merged into one.

The Taotie’s Law also seemed to melt into his body.

On Mo Hua’s skin, the ancient and sinister Taotie Patterns rose and fell, emanating an eerie blue light.

Making Mo Hua as a whole look like a "human-shaped Taotie."

As if a human flesh harbored a Taotie.

As if a Taotie transformed into a "human form."

This was the Great Wilderness Twelve Classics Taotie Spirit Remains Formation from the hands of the mysterious Great Witch, sealed within the skull of an Evil God.

It is said to claim the creation of heaven and earth, pursuing the secret of Human Dao, transforming the fierce law of Taotie.
